UPDATE ebay_price_audit_task t SET processed_oe = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebay_price_audit_oe o WHERE o.task_id = t.id AND o.query_status IN ('SUCCESS', 'EMPTY', 'FAILED')), success_oe = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebay_price_audit_oe o WHERE o.task_id = t.id AND o.query_status = 'SUCCESS'), empty_oe = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebay_price_audit_oe o WHERE o.task_id = t.id AND o.query_status = 'EMPTY'), failed_oe = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebay_price_audit_oe o WHERE o.task_id = t.id AND o.query_status = 'FAILED'), reviewed_oe = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebay_price_audit_oe o WHERE o.task_id = t.id AND o.review_status <> 'PENDING'), selected_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebay_price_audit_item i WHERE i.task_id = t.id AND i.selected_flag = '1'), query_end_time = CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebay_price_audit_oe o WHERE o.task_id = t.id AND o.query_status IN ('SUCCESS', 'EMPTY', 'FAILED')) = t.total_oe THEN COALESCE(t.query_end_time, NOW()) ELSE NULL END, status = CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebay_price_audit_oe o WHERE o.task_id = t.id AND o.query_status IN ('SUCCESS', 'EMPTY', 'FAILED')) < t.total_oe THEN 'QUERYING' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ebay_price_audit_oe o WHERE o.task_id = t.id AND o.review_status = 'PENDING') = 0 THEN 'COMPLETED' ELSE 'REVIEWING' END WHERE t.id = #{taskId}
